headline: 2026 NFL Schedule Announced
subhead: Complete 18-Week, 272-Game Regular-Season Schedule Available on NFL.com

facts.label: Regular-season length
facts.quote: The NFL announced its 18-week, 272-game regular-season schedule for 2026

facts.label: Kickoff game
facts.quote: kicks off on Wednesday night, September 9, in Seattle

facts.label: Final week
facts.quote: concludes with 16 division games in Week 18 – three on Saturday, January 9, and 13 on Sunday, January 10

facts.label: Games per club
facts.quote: each team playing 17 regular-season games and three preseason games

facts.label: International games
facts.quote: The NFL schedule features nine international games, the most-ever in a season

limits: The announcement text does not list every game; the full slate is on the official by-week PDF linked from the announcement and on the NFL.com schedule pages.
